full_judgment:
This Rule was issued calling upon the opposite party to show cause as to why the judgment and decree dated 27-8-1997 passed in Title Appeal No. 129 of 1993 by the learned Subordinate Judge, Artha Rin Adalat, Kushtia dismissing the appeal and affirming the judgment dated 30-5-1993 passed by the learned Additional Assistant Judge, Kushtia, Sadar, in Title Suit No. 28 of 1990 should not be set aside. 

 5. The learned Assistant Judge decreed the suit on finding that the plaintiff failed to prove her case. On appeal, the learned Appellate Court affirmed the judgment and decree passed by the learned trial Court. 

 7. Mr Parimal Chandra Guha, the learned Advocate appearing for the petitioners, could not assail the judgment and decree passed by the learned Court of appeal below on any count.
